newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Nov state borrowing need seen 8 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Nov state borrowing need seen 8 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's state borrowing requirement for November was forecast at eight billion crowns on Wednesday by the National Debt Office.
The forecast for October was cut from a forecast of a borrowing need of five billion crowns to a surplus of seven billion crowns.
The actual borrowing level for September was confirmed at zero against previous forecasts for a borrowing requirement of five billion crowns.
The office left unchanged its forecast for calendar 1996 at 40 to 50 billion crowns.
The office said it planned to issue 14 billion crowns in treasury bills and four billion crowns in bonds in November.
It said it would issue 13 billion crowns in treasury bills and nine billion crowns in bonds at three auctions in October.
